problem.description: This intent filter has the format of an Android App Link but is missing the autoVerify attribute; add android:autoVerify="true" to ensure your domain will be validated and enable App Link-related Lint warnings. If you do not want clicked URLs to bring the user to your app, remove the android.intent.category.BROWSABLE category, or set android:autoVerify="false" to make it clear this is not intended to be an Android App Link.
